envelope.description: Summariser: the error placeholder keeps a good summary

body.title: Summariser: the error placeholder keeps a good summary
body.summary: In summariseDoc's placeholder branch (src/analyze/summariser/driver.ts:238-242) call writeDocSummaryIfCurrent with { keepGoodSummary: true } and return { ok: false, skipped: 'kept-good', errorCode, errorMessage } for 'kept-good'; add 'kept-good' to SummariseDocResult.skipped (src/analyze/summariser/driver.ts:157) with its doc comment. The successful-write branch (:278-281) and the sweep classification (src/indexer/doc-summary-sweep.ts:56-58) stay as they are.
acceptanceChecks: A summary stored while the model runs is kept when the model then fails, and the result is skipped 'kept-good'.
A failing model with no stored summary still writes the placeholder as before.
The sweep counts a kept-good result as skipped, not failed.
The existing summarise-doc-current tests pass unchanged.

tests.name: src/analyze/summariser/__tests__/summarise-doc-current.test.ts: 'a summary stored while the model runs is kept when the model then fails (the placeholder is not written)'
src/indexer/__tests__/doc-summary-sweep.test.ts: 'a kept-good result is counted as skipped, not failed'
